current_evidence: The council's Planning Application Validation Requirements page links 'Local list of validation requirements – 2026 update' (PDF), and the PDF text is dated February 2026; the workbook links the companion 'Validation checklist – 2026 update' .docx form instead.

issues.detail: The 'Validation list URL' points to the 19KB Validation Checklist .docx (a tick-box form that WebFetch reads as binary), not the local list itself. The local list is the companion PDF 'Local List of Validation Requirements 2026 Update'. The date of Feb 2026 is right, but it comes from the URL path, not from the document text.
issues.evidence: Validation page lists 'Local list of validation requirements – 2026 update' (pdf) and, separately, 'Validation checklist – 2026 update' (docx); PDF is dated February 2026

issues.detail: Householder is marked '(none) national requirements only', but the list has a dedicated Householder section with 10 local requirements: Validation Checklist (all), Site Photographs (all), Floor/Roof plans (roof plans only where roof altered), Elevations/Street scene (works to front/side fronting a road incl. roof additions at first floor and above), Sections & site levels (sloping sites/changed levels), Sustainability Checklist & Statement (all householder), Basement Impact Assessment (basements), Arboricultural report (TPO trees or conservation area), Flood Risk Assessment (FZ2/3 incl. outbuildings), Heritage Statement (affects heritage assets).

Non-householder local requirements missing from app_type_rows: Care Needs Assessment (specialist/supported/older people's accommodation); Consent Form for Payment of Council Related Costs (1+ net new dwellings, S106 legal fees, or review of technical assessments); Contaminated Land Report (potential contamination or vulnerable receptors); Housing Needs Survey (small-scale rural exception schemes); Retail/Leisure Impact Assessment (>2,500 sqm or out/edge-of-centre main town centre uses); Sunlight/Daylight Assessment (adverse neighbour light impact or new homes in restricted setting); Statement of Community Involvement (departures, >10,000 sqm non-residential, sites 3ha+, >100 dwellings, controversial); Glint and Glare Assessment (solar PV affecting receptors); Fire Risk Assessment / Battery Management Plan (battery storage); Affordable Housing Statement (11+ homes or >1,000 sqm) under Full planning.

Affordable Housing Statement, Flood Risk Assessment, Basement Impact Assessment and Heritage Statement are placed under 'Works to trees' because the extracted table text ran into the tree survey trigger ('Where there are trees protected by TPO...'). None of these is a works-to-trees requirement. Landscape and Visual Impact Assessment is placed under 'Listed building consent', but the list requires it for 50+ residential units and major commercial schemes such as solar farms.
issues.evidence: LVIA: 'Residential developments of 50 or more units and major commercial applications'; Affordable Housing: '11 or more homes, or more than 1,000 sqm'

issues.detail: About 30 rows are labelled 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning'. The list applies them to all non-householder applications, not only Full planning. For example, Refuse and Recycling covers 'all development that generates waste, except householder', and the Sustainability Checklist covers 'all minor and major applications'. Reserved matters, outline and others are left as '(none)'.

Several trigger excerpts are taken from the wrong requirement or are garbled. 'Habitats Regulations Assessment / SPA mitigation' carries the Air Quality trigger text, but the HRA/air quality modelling for Epping Forest SAC applies to all new residential and non-residential proposals. 'Noise Impact Assessment' carries the Glint and Glare and HRA headings instead of the noise trigger. 'Health Impact Assessment' runs into the Housing Needs Survey heading. 'Agricultural Land Classification' carries the Agricultural Buildings Appraisal trigger, not its own (loss of BMV land Grades 1-3a, change of use from agriculture, e.g. solar farms). 'BNG' runs on into 'NATIONAL REQUIREMENTS Completed Application Form'.
issues.evidence: PDF: HRA 'All new residential and non-residential proposals'; ALC 'loss of agricultural land (especially Grades 1, 2 and 3a)'

issues.detail: Several triggers are fragments with no condition, for example Construction Management Plan ('Strategy, or Construction Management Plan where required.'), Marketing ('in the loss of employment uses.'), Structural Survey ('to the structural survey.'), Water efficiency ('management and water efficiency in the area.') and Site levels ('to existing ground levels...'). The source triggers are: Structural Survey for barn/rural building conversions and demolition of listed or positive conservation-area buildings; Marketing Appraisal for applications resulting in loss of employment uses.

Several tab items and rows come from the Harlow & Gilston Garden Town Sustainability Guidance (2021), which is a guidance document, not the local list: the contents-page fragment 'SUSTAINABILITY GUIDANCE & CHECKLIST MARCH 2021 Interactive PDF...', 'Heat Decision Tree (pgs 76 - 77) pdf Appendix 4:', 'DM 2 Epping Forest SAC and the Lee Valley SPA', the SANG definition text, the 'Design Code / Masterplan' row (passive solar gain text) and the 'Waste / Refuse' row (checklist question text). Drawing-standard fragments such as 'Key dimensions; and Drawing numbers.' are also not requirements.

The same trigger text is reused for several different requirements: Agricultural dwelling appraisal and ALC share one trigger; Floor plans/Elevations and Street scene share one; Energy/Sustainability Statement and Sustainability checklist share one.

summary: The workbook links the companion checklist .docx rather than the February 2026 local list PDF; the date is right. The extraction misses the whole householder local list and several non-householder items, and it puts several requirements under the wrong application type (Works to trees, Listed building consent).
